## Summary

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests and the mandatory security baseline pass.
- [ ] Applicable security controls and negative tests were reviewed.
- [ ] Non-applicable controls and temporary exceptions have substantive reasons.
- [ ] No credentials, private repository details, or sensitive data are exposed.

## Compatibility

- [ ] PR title uses Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Breaking workflow inputs or security defaults use `!` / `BREAKING CHANGE:`.
- [ ] README and migration guidance describe behavior changes.
- [ ] Release impact is identified: patch / minor / major.
